gloss: raw sliced horse meat; horse sashimi

definitions.gloss: raw sliced horse meat; horse sashimi
definitions.explanation: Thinly sliced raw horse meat, eaten with soy sauce, grated ginger, and garlic. A regional specialty of Kumamoto and parts of Nagano, and a common izakaya dish elsewhere.

examples.japanese: {馬刺|ばさ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
{馬刺|ばさ}し⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧{醤油|じょうゆ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Basashi tastes good eaten with ginger and soy sauce.

examples.japanese: {熊本|くまもと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}ったら→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦{名物|めいぶつ}→名物：05591_meibutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{馬刺|ばさ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぜひ⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧みて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you go to Kumamoto, be sure to try basashi, the local specialty.

notes:
{馬|ば} (horse) + ⟦{刺|さ}し→刺す：02111_sasu⟧, a shortening of ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧. The same pattern gives {鳥刺|とりさ}し (raw chicken) and {鹿刺|しかさ}し (raw venison).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {馬刺|ばさ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat basashi
- {馬刺|ばさ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{盛|も}り{合|あ}わせ→盛り合わせ：21762_moriawase⟧: an assorted plate of basashi
- {熊本|くまもと}⟦{名物|めいぶつ}→名物：05591_meibutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{馬刺|ばさ}し: basashi, the specialty of Kumamoto

CULTURAL NOTE:
Horse meat is called ⟦{桜肉|さくらにく}→桜肉：30454_sakuraniku⟧ ('cherry blossom meat') for its pink color, and {馬刺|ばさ}し is the most common way it is served. It is considered a delicacy rather than everyday food, and is usually eaten in restaurants rather than cooked at home.
